savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: it is hereby ordered that the following Executive Orders, and any amendments thereto, are revoked:

conclusion: EO 12553 (signed 1986-02-25, 51 FR 7237-7243) is a one-paragraph cleanup revocation of a table of 332 targeted numbered orders in the Lambertini packet (about 300 in the table) 'and any amendments thereto'. It states no effective date (so effective on signing), no savings, continuation, transfer, pending-matter or exception clause, and its stated purpose is 'to eliminate Executive Orders that are no longer necessary'. It therefore neither saves nor extinguishes any residual of a listed order: any residual (rights, transfers, accrued effects) must come from the revoked order itself. The OCR of the table is column-scrambled on PDF pages 9 and 11, so the number-to-subject pairing is read from the number columns; every target in this batch appears in a number column (10933 and 10965 and 11011 on p. 12, 11622 and 11663 and 11694 on p. 13, 12491 on p. 15).
